comment.comment:
$Wojak $Troll face $Hugh Johnson

Read these three names again. 👀

Wojak and Trollface are two of the most legendary memes in internet history. Almost everyone has seen them. Millions of people grew up laughing at them.

Now imagine a character with that same meme potential, but this time he lives inside GTA 6. 🤯

Think about that for a second.

GTA isn’t just a game. It’s part of our childhood. Almost everyone on this planet knows GTA, whether they’ve played it or not.

Now GTA 6 is bringing its own social media world inside the game, and Hugh Johnson is part of that universe.

A meme inside one of the biggest games in history.

And @MichaelSuppo sees the potential. He is comparing Hugh to legendary internet memes like Wojak and Trollface.

This is the same suppoman I’ve followed for years. A guy who has spotted so many incredible meme opportunities, including massive 100x runners.

And here’s the crazy part…

$HUGH is sitting around just $100K market cap.

Sometimes the biggest opportunities look so small in the beginning that nobody takes them seriously.

I’m not saying every meme becomes a legend.

But imagine if Hugh becomes one of those characters people keep sharing, laughing at, and remembering for years.

Wojak came from the internet.
Trollface came from the internet.
Hugh Johnson comes from the world of GTA 6. 🌴

If you understand meme culture, you understand how powerful that could be.

Don’t underestimate a funny character with the right story behind him.

I see something special here. HUGH 🔥
